    https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2109307644846444808?s=20

    [![](https://assets.faireconomy.media/nfs/npd/2025/02/26/npd_09_27_29.v2.png)](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2109307644846444808?s=20)

     [![](https://nfs.faireconomy.media/x_twitter_user_profile_images/1120633726478823425/OpGKpqx9_200x200.jpg)Volodymyr Zelenskyy / Володимир Зеленський @ZelenskyyUa](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/) [![](https://www.forexfactory.com/resources/svg/images/logo/x.svg?4d3eeb85)](https://x.com/ZelenskyyUa/status/2109307644846444808)
